The default bind is 127.0.0.1, which works for an Android emulator via 10.0.2.2 but silently refuses every connection from a real phone on the LAN - the app installs, opens, and fails every request. This exposes the emulator suite to the local network, which is acceptable for a development machine holding fake money and would never be done for anything real.
